description.zh: 待修改密码的账号名，您可以调用[DescribeAccounts](~~473816~~)获取。
description.en: The username of the account for which you want to change the password. You can call the [DescribeAccounts](~~473816~~) operation to query the username of the account.

description.zh: 该账号要设置的新密码。密码长度为8~32位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的至少三种，特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
description.en: The new password to be set for the account. The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length and contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and specific special characters. These special characters include `! @ # $ % ^ & * ( ) _ + - =`

description.zh:
该账号的原密码。

> 如果忘记账号的密码，您也可以调用[ResetAccountPassword](~~473815~~)接口重置密码。
description.en:
The current password of the account.
 
> If you forget your password, you can call the [ResetAccountPassword](~~473815~~) operation to reset your password.

description.zh: 本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入。
description.en: This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun r-kvstore modify-account-password --instance-id r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000 --account-name testaccount --old-account-password oldPassWd9990000 --new-account-password newPassWd8880000 --source-biz SDK --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun r-kvstore ModifyAccountPassword --region cn-hangzhou --OldAccountPassword oldPassWd9990000 --InstanceId 'r-bp1zxszhcgatnx0000' --NewAccountPassword newPassWd8880000 --SourceBiz SDK --AccountName testaccount
